test.create_query: CREATE TABLE skip_index_planning AS hits_10m_single ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(EventDate) ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID)) SAMPLE BY intHash32(UserID) SETTINGS add_minmax_index_for_numeric_columns = 1, add_minmax_index_for_temporal_columns = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO skip_index_planning SELECT * FROM hits_10m_single LIMIT 100000
